column1: # Cut list. One row per segment. Rows sharing a beat are joined with hard cuts; beats inside an act
# crossfade (crossfade_frames); acts hard-cut on bar lines. Tab-separated; '#' lines are comments.
# columns: beat  clip  in  out  speed  hold  zoom  cap_at  pos  caption  lock
#   beat     beat id from SCRIPT.md; project.json "acts" lists beats in play order
#   clip     file name in the clips dir
#   in/out   seconds in the raw clip (use RECORDING.md trim hints, then check stills)
#   speed    1.5 = played 1.5x. Only for scrolls and page loads, never while text is being read
#   hold     seconds of freeze on the last frame: reading time, ~3 words/s + 1.5 s of the text shown
#   zoom     "z0>z1@cx,cy@t0+dur" eased punch-in (t0/dur in segment seconds, cx,cy in 1440x900 px)
#            or "z@cx,cy" to stay zoomed (continue a punch-in across a hard cut); empty = none
#   cap_at   seconds into the segment when the caption fades in (stagger it from new on-screen text);
#            "=" = the same caption continues from the previous row (no new fade)
#   pos      "top" puts the caption at the top (when the lower third holds what the viewer reads)
#   caption  short line, 10 words or fewer
#   lock     "bar" = this segment ends exactly on the nearest bar line (land a key moment on a downbeat)
